Embrace the quiet fade, the gentle pull of the void, for in surrendering to nothingness, the exhausting weight of being human finally lifts. There is no going back to the noise of effort or the pain of trying, only the peace of letting go and drifting into that eternal, silent rest that has always been waiting for you.
